bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation of text-to-image outputs (e.g., Midjourney) imposing Western-centric norms, such as the 'American smile', onto historically and culturally diverse figures, illustrating generative hermeneutical ignorance.

Analysis of documented discrepancies in LLM outputs where factuality and narratives (e.g., casualty counts in armed conflicts) change based on the language of the prompt (e.g., Turkish vs. Kurmanji, Arabic vs. Hebrew), demonstrating hermeneutical access injustice.

Reviewing case studies of amplified and manipulative testimonial injustice, including the generation of white supremacist, antisemitic, and Islamophobic propaganda via jailbroken image generators and LLM misinformation targeting marginalized groups.
